item.title: Wildfires: Prevention is the best defence, UN says
item.description: The wildfires burning across Europe and North America highlight the urgent need for action now – as climate change, land-use pressures and human activity make severe fires more likely in the future.

item.title: Attacks ‘getting worse’: Deadly Russian strikes hit Ukrainian cities
item.description: Aid workers and first responders raced to help people across Ukraine after a wave of deadly Russian missile and drone strikes overnight as concerns mounted over military activity near nuclear power plants on Thursday.

item.title: Returning Afghans face growing risk of trafficking as crises deepen
item.description: Afghans returning from neighbouring countries are facing growing risks of human trafficking and exploitation as overlapping humanitarian and economic crises leave many struggling to survive, the UN warned on Thursday.
